correctness.rationale: Set k=2n+2,r=3n+4,N=k+r. A=A_{z^k}^{z^N}, Ue_j=e_{3j}, Q extracts e_{r+2j}; QU=0 makes I−UQ invertible with inverse I+UQ. The perturbation AUQ has rank n and ker(A−AUQ)=(I+UQ)G for G=span(e_r,...,e_{N−1}). Modulo this kernel, S* acts on the free g coefficients by independent low monomials e_(r−1), e_(3j−1), e_(3j), hence quotient dimension 2n+1 and it is minimal because all kernel members vanish at 0. Independently checked exact symbolic matrices and full quotient rank for n=1,...,5; the every-n quantifier follows from the symbolic coordinate identity.
residual_risks: Distinct monomial low-degree coordinates and free high-degree parameters must be established for every n, not inferred from five tests.
